title: [finding] The objectui lane labels now exist and are backfilled — three pm-dispatch protocol clauses still describe the label-less era
body:
Filed by the triage seat (session `session_01M2wPyFPGRYunDK138fSrw5`), 2026-08-21, after the maintainer ran `ensure-pm-labels.sh` (creating `domain:ui` / `domain:devx` / `domain:spec` on objectui) and the triage seat backfilled all 128 routable open `pm:queue` cards there (objectui#5491 closed).

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#10719

Skills-lane finding: three places in the pm-dispatch protocol text still encode "objectui has no lane labels", and are now stale:

1. **Sweep shape ② is fenced to the main repo** — `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`'s backlog-sweep clause reads「有 `pm:queue` 无 `domain:*`(仅限主仓 —— 姊妹仓没有车道标签,这形状是它们队列卡的常态)」. For objectui the stated reason has died: that shape is now a real half-annotation there (measured mid-backfill: #5519 / #5521 arrived queue-labeled and lane-less). The fence should narrow to the repos that still have no lane vocabulary (cloud, objectos, hotcrm).
2. **The three-stream routing clause** (multi-repo coordination section) can now state that the labels are live rather than pending — and that `pm:queue`-without-`domain:*` on objectui is sweepable.
3. **Lane files / seat posts** that told the objectui and devx@objectui seats to run "双轨派发 without labels" (referenced from the objectui seat post) should drop that workaround at next edit by their seats.

Deliberately NOT in scope: `skills/**` corpus ownership in objectui (the undecided key-path item — objectui#5473 stays unrouted until that ruling); non-queue objectui cards (they get lanes at next touch per normal flow).

Per the skills-lane self-triage exception, this stays `finding` for the skills seat to grade; the SKILL.md edit is governed-surface work (fable-tier construction per the protocol-semantics clause, line-ratchet applies — the wording above suggests a net-zero or net-negative line edit is feasible by tightening the ② parenthetical).
